name: Animal Sounds
brief: Toddler animal sound board + 'who says this?' game: 40+ animals drawn as your own SVG, real-sounding audio (use CC0/public-domain recordings only if you can fetch them with a license you record in the app's credits; otherwise synthesize convincing sounds with WebAudio and never claim 'real recordings'), habitats pages, gentle quiz with no failure state.

name: Basic Math for Kids
brief: Early math for ages 4-8: counting objects, addition/subtraction within 20 with visual manipulatives (blocks, beads), number line, compare bigger/smaller; adaptive difficulty; sticker rewards; distinct from MultiplicationGame (times tables) and CountingApp (counting 1-100).

name: Counting Fun
brief: Becomes a kids counting game (TallyCounter is the adult tally tool): count animals/objects 1-20 then 1-100 with voice, tap-to-count, number tracing, skip-counting songs (synthesized melodies), sticker book.

name: Dinosaur World
brief: Kids dinosaur explorer: 30+ dinosaurs drawn as your own SVG with simple facts (size vs a school bus, diet, era), fossil-dig mini game, size-compare slider, puzzle; facts checked and age-appropriate.

name: Emotion Flash
brief: Emotions flashcards for kids (social-emotional learning): 24 emotions as expressive SVG faces, name/recognise/match games, 'how would you feel?' scenarios, calm-down breathing card; no therapy or medical claims.

name: Kids Coloring
brief: Big-shape coloring book for small hands: 100+ original outline pictures drawn as SVG paths (no licensed characters), tap-to-fill + brush, stickers, save to gallery inside the app; distinct from MandalaColor (adult) and PixelArt (number pixels).

name: Kids Drum
brief: Toddler drum kit: 6 big colourful pads with synthesized sounds, play-along patterns that light up, animal-drummer characters, record & replay; distinct from DrumMachine (adult step sequencer).

name: Kids Piano
brief: Kids piano with 8-13 big keys, light-up song tutor for public-domain nursery songs, animal-sound key mode, xylophone mode; distinct from PianoKeyboard (adult full keyboard).

name: Multiplication Game
brief: Kids times-tables arcade game (TimesTable is the adult study tool): feed-the-monster answers, table-by-table progression with stars, visual arrays explaining multiplication, gentle timing (no pressure mode default).

name: Shapes & Colors
brief: Shapes and colours for ages 2-5: sort shapes into holes, colour mixing play, find-the-shape scenes, voice prompts, sticker rewards.
